newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Max to raise NZ$460,000 via placement.
newsitem.headline: Max to raise NZ$460,000 via placement.

text.p: Max Resources said on Monday it had agreed to a conditional placement of 2.3 million fully-paid shares at NZ$0.20/share to raise $460,000 to fund the possible acquisition of another business.
Max said the shares were being placed with two Australian professional investors, whom it did not name.

"The placement is conditional upon the funds being used, within the next 14 days, exclusively in relation to the international industrial business which the company is continuing to assess," Max said.
"Should Max not acquire any interest in this business then the placement will not proceed and any funds received from these investors will be fully repaid to them."
